title: sdks: unify auth/retries, streaming ergonomics; parity fixes & v1.59.0 version bumps
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Motivation: Unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs to improve parity and prepare for v1.59.0 release; this PR combines API ergonomics, bug fixes for streaming cancellation and retry semantics, and version bumps for all three SDKs. Changes include: - Python: new AuthSession abstraction, unified exponential backoff via core/retry, streaming AsyncIterator wrapper with explicit cancellation tokens and improved reconnect logic; - TypeScript: stabilize streaming ReadableStream wrapper, add onError retry hook, align auth header refresh behavior with Python; - Go: introduce auth.Session interface, move backoff policy to internal/backoff, streaming client supports context cancellation and structured event decoding. Checklist: - [x] API design doc approved (ENG-2319); - [x] unit tests for auth/retry path added; - [x] streaming e2e tests flakiness reduced; - [x] changelogs and migration guide updated; - [x] bump package versions for release. Backwards compatibility: no breaking changes to the top-level APIs used by customers; a small number of internal helpers were renamed (migration note included).
commits: ef3a7c2 - sdk(common): extract retry/backoff interface and default implementation
b41d9f1 - sdk/python: add AuthSession, streaming cancellation token, tests
c7a2b55 - sdk/typescript: streaming wrapper + onError hook, auth refresh alignment
d5f9eaa - sdk/go: introduce auth.Session, move backoff policies, streaming context support
f0b12de - docs: migration guide and changelogs for v1.59.0
review_comments: Jamal Reed: Left a few nits on retry.py; suggest making backoff policy injectable for easier testing.
Anika Patel: Confirmed TypeScript streaming ergonomics; one suggestion to expose onClose event for consumer cleanup.
Ethan Cole: Verified go streaming cancellation with context; found a race in client reconnect, requested small mutex around reconnect logic.
Sofia Martinez (author): Addressed comments, added tests for injectable backoff, exposed onClose in TS API, fixed reconnect mutex, pushed follow-up commits.
release_notes: v1.59.0 - SDK parity and ergonomics: unified auth and retry semantics across Python/TS/Go; improved streaming cancellation and reconnection logic; added migration guide; bug fixes and tests. Non-breaking (recommended migration steps documented).
related_issue_notes: See ENG-2319 for design discussion and ENG-2345 for release coordination. This PR bundles multiple smaller fixes to reduce churn across release candidates.
oss_compatibility: Package bumps: python->1.59.0, typescript->1.59.0, go->v1.59.0; ensured semver compatibility for public APIs
